serverInfo.name: pharmacare-mcp-server
serverInfo.description: Custom Local MCP Server for Pharmacy Inventory Search, Stock Checking, and Order Creation.

tools.name: search_medications
tools.description: Searches for medications based on name, symptom, or category.

parameters.query: String (required) - Name of medication or patient symptom (e.g. fever, headache, acid reflux).

tools.returns: JSON array of matching medications with price, stock, and prescription requirements.

tools.name: check_inventory
tools.description: Checks current stock level and price for a given medication ID.

parameters.medication_id: String (required) - Unique ID of the medication (e.g. MED-001).

tools.returns: Stock count, unit price, availability flag, and prescription requirement.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Creates a home delivery purchase order for one or more medications.

parameters.items: Array of objects [{ medication_id: string, quantity: number }] (required).

tools.returns: Order summary including generated order ID, total price, and status.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Retrieves the status of an existing purchase order.
tools.returns: Complete order status and item list.
